title: Chapter 565 - 565 Mission Completed; Good Luck?! (2)
content:
Chapter 565 - 565 Mission Completed; Good Luck?! (2)

Chapter 565 - 565 Mission Completed; Good Luck?! (2)

565 Mission Completed; Good Luck?! (2)

“Dad, Mom! We’re back!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted before she even walked into the house.

After pushing open the door, Lin Xiaoyao praised, “Wow! It smells so good!”

She looked at the large table of dishes. “Braised pork ribs, glutinous rice fish, shredded potatoes, green beans, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, loofah soup… Wow! They’re all my favorite foods! Great!”

As she spoke, she took a piece of pork rib from the bowl and put it into her mouth.

“Delicious!”

Dai Weixue scolded, “You’re already in university, but you’re still using your hands to eat!”

“Mom, it’s all because your cooking skills are too good. I can’t help it,” Lin Xiaoyao said with a smile.

As soon as she finished speaking, she took another piece of pork rib and stuffed it into her mouth.

“Your culinary skills are top-notch!”

Dai Weixue smiled and shook her head. “Go wash your hands and eat.”

“Alright!” Lin Xiaoyao said.

“Lil Fan, do you want some?” Lin Tao asked.

“Why are you letting Lil Fan drink? He’s a professor. He can’t drink.” Dai Weixue blamed her husband.

“Oh, right,” said Lin Tao.

Lin Fan smiled. “Dad, Mom, professors can drink. It’s fine.”

“Is that so?” Lin Tao said hesitantly.

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

As he spoke, he poured himself a glass of wine.

“Dad, cheers.”

“Alright, cheers.”

After a glass of wine, Lin Tao asked, “I heard that you created a sun? Won’t it be very hot in the future?”

Lin Fan understood that his father was talking about controllable nuclear fusion. He explained, “It’s just like the sun. It can provide an endless supply of energy. To put it simply, it allows us to use cheaper electricity and ride cheaper cars…”

“Oh, so that’s how it is…” Lin Tao nodded.

Eating together as a family was always so simple and warm.

The night gradually deepened.

Lin Fan lay on the big bed that had just been basked in the sun. His face was filled with a blissful smile.

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

When the sun rose and the sky was dyed red, Lin Fan opened his eyes.

He glanced at his phone out of habit.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 36,892,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, he placed his attention on the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

Lin Fan pursed his lips and threw his phone to the side. Then, he slowly got up.

After washing up, he went to the breakfast stall with Lin Xiaoyao and ordered a bowl of wontons.

Lin Xiaoyao said, “The wontons at home are the most delicious. The ones from Jiangbei don’t taste right.”

Lin Fan said, “Eat more. That way, your face will be rounder and it’ll feel nicer to pinch.”

As he spoke, Lin Fan raised his hand and pinched Lin Xiaoyao’s cheek. “Your face is too thin.”

“Brother!” Lin Xiaoyao rebuked.

After breakfast, Lin Xiaoyao chose to go home to catch up on her sleep.

Lin Fan strolled around the streets.

Familiar buildings and familiar streets… Everything was so beautiful.

At this moment, the phone in his pocket vibrated slightly.

Lin Fan opened it and saw that it was a WeChat message from Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

Xia Bing: [Professor Lin, we just received the International Computer Innovation Award. Certificate.jpg.]

Xia Xue: [Professor Lin, we just got the International Computer Innovation Award. Certificate.jpg.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up. They had received an international award, which meant… he had completed one-third of his mission as a new teacher!

[Mission—become a teacher. Teach five students and let them receive three international awards (1/3). Reward: five golden packets and a special skill.]

As expected!

Lin Fan replied: [Well done!]

…

After Xia Bing and Xia Xue sent the message, they held the phones tightly with both hands. They kept staring at them, not daring to think of anything else. Their heartbeats continued to accelerate…

The next moment, their phones vibrated slightly.

The two of them had smiles more brilliant than blooming flowers.

…

Lin Fan continued to stroll around.

Not long after, his phone vibrated again.

Hao Zhiwu: [Professor Lin, I got the International Neurology Research Award! Certificate.jpg.]

Lin Fan replied: [Not bad!]

[Hehe, it’s all thanks to you… It’s not just because you taught me knowledge, but also because you’re bold and careful. When I walked up to the podium, I was very nervous and afraid. However, when I thought about how you were very calm when you received the Nobel Prize, I wasn’t afraid or nervous…]

Hao Zhiwu sent a long message.

Luckily, Lin Fan had the scanning ability, so he could read everything in an instant.

Lin Fan: [All the best!]

Then, Lin Fan put his phone into his pocket and thought to himself, ‘Now, as long as Jiang Chaoqun’s certificate is in hand, the mission will be completed.’

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and Hao Zhiwu all got their certificates today. Would Jiang Chaoqun also get it today?

If that was the case, he would be able to complete the mission today!

However, things… often went against one’s wishes.

Even at night, Lin Fan still had not received a message from Jiang Chaoqun.

The next day, at 11 AM…

Suddenly, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed the mission—become a teacher: Teach five students and let them receive three international awards (3/3). You’ve received five golden packets and a special skill.]

The mission!

It was done!

[Congratulations, you’ve obtained the skill Heartbeat.]

[Heartbeat: Possesses the special ability to listen to the thoughts of the other party. The more you listen, the more charming you are!]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

Hear the other party’s thoughts?

This was definitely a very good skill!

It was really worth spending so much time as a professor to teach students.

Not bad, not bad!

…

On the other hand, Jiang Chaoqun, who had just received his certificate, sent a message to Lin Fan immediately.

However, even after waiting for a long time, Lin Fan did not reply.

“Maybe the professor is busy with other projects,” Jiang Chaoqun muttered.

How could he know that Lin Fan was completely immersed in the joy of hearing other people’s inner thoughts?

…

After a while, Lin Fan finally stopped feeling happy about the new skill.

He then turned his attention to the five golden packets and one platinum packet.

The five golden packets were the rewards from this mission.

The platinum packet was the reward from the controllable nuclear fusion plant.

“I’ll open the golden packets first.”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 900,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a Dimensional Multiplication Card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 500,000 yuan.]

As for the 1.5 million yuan that he obtained, as well as the one yuan critical hit card…

Lin Fan did not care about them.

He immediately placed his attention on the Dimensional Multiplication Card.

[Dimensional Multiplication Card: After use, the inner space will randomly increase by one to ten times.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up once more.

He had personally experienced the magic of the inner space. It was a magical space that could allow objects to instantly enter his body with a slight thought.

This space was only ten square meters.

Previously, Lin Fan had felt that there was simply too little space.

Now, there was finally a chance for growth!

“Use it!”

[Ding! It was used successfully. Congratulations, your inner space has increased by five times!] Your current inner space is 50 square meters.]

Lin Fan looked at the inner space that had expanded and revealed a satisfied look.

First, he obtained the ability to listen to the thoughts of others.

After that, he obtained the Dimensional Multiplication Card.

It seemed like… today’s luck was pretty good!

Then, Lin Fan’s eyes landed on the last platinum packet with a look of incomparable anticipation.

“Open!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the skill—Beginner Fasting Technique.]

Another skill?

[Beginner Fasting Technique: After using it, it can greatly reduce the energy consumption of the human body and extract energy from the natural world, so that your body will not be affected even if you do not eat or drink for a month.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s lips curled up. Fasting? Was this like the immortal cultivation talked about in legends?

In the next moment…

The smile on Lin Fan’s face froze as he stood rooted to the spot.

That was because another crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! A total of one million red packets have been opened, and a doomsday mission has been unlocked.]
